Meet the Founder

Adeyemo Rhodes-Vivour

Founder, Oak Cherry Kraft

At Oak Cherry Kraft, we believe great furniture creates lasting value. Led by Adeyemo Rhodes-Vivour, our studio creates bespoke furniture that balances elegance, durability, and functionality.

Every project begins with understanding the client's vision and ends with carefully crafted furniture made specifically for its space.
